fusions.name: Twelve-Point Leap
fusions.desc: Leaps at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 30 piercing damage, rising to double that at 7 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Startle Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out around you, dealing 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushed From Cover
fusions.desc: Bursts 4 tiles forward, then your movement speed rises by 30% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Blow Slipped
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
